description: Balancing energy prices components per quarter-hour (Near real-time) is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. Prices of the components used to calculate the imbalance price per quarter hour. All published values are non-validated values and can therefore only be used for information purposes. This report contains data for the current day and is refreshed every 15min.﻿This dataset contains data from 22/05/2024 (MARI local go-live) on. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Balancing. Its keywords are Activation. The portal shows 2026-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
